phone.notes: You can hack DIM cards with the new Hacker Ticket: one Digimon fights every Digimon of a card one against one, with no healing in between. The Tamer page shows the coins of your extra steps. If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: The watch face can show the data you choose (date, heart rate, battery...) and has a new plate. The steps past the daily limit of the tamer now give coins (from the server). If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports.
